dct_title_s: Satellite-detected water extents in Mananjary District, Vatovavy Fitovinany Region, Madagascar as of 27 February 2022
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: TC20220221MDG** This map illustrates satellite-detected surface waters in Mananjary district, Vatovavy Fitovinany region, Madagascar as observed from a Sentinel-1 image acquired on 27 February 2022 at 05:12 local time. Within the analyzed area of about 200 km2, about 6 km2 of lands appear to be flooded. Based on Worldpop population data and the detected surface waters, about 200 people are potentially exposed or living close to flooded areas. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Important note: Flood analysis from radar images may underestimate the presence of standing waters in built-up areas and densely vegetated areas due to backscattering properties of the radar signal.
